title: replay budget

setup.note: A deterministic synthetic 63-day corpus replayed at Balanced (the real 63-day WhatsApp corpus was removed in S0.6): WhatsApp across 25 streams (5 with open tasks), screen frames with heartbeat repeats, browser visits with occasional 4-page bursts.

input_events: ≈ 470 events/day for 63 days, driven through the dispatcher with the clock at each arrival and each due window

wrong.label: idle-rule-firing
wrong.assert_absent: more than 200 flushes on any day
